name: portfolio-demo
description: A premium, dark-themed personal portfolio showcasing backend expertise in Python, FastAPI, and Django, alongside advanced OpenCV AI projects. Built with React and Vite.

paragraphs: A premium, high-performance personal portfolio website showcasing backend expertise, scalable systems, and computer vision projects. Designed with a sleek, dark-themed aesthetic featuring cyan-violet accents and smooth micro-animations.
features: 🚀 Modern UI/UX: Built with React 19 and Vite for lightning-fast performance and a premium look.
🎨 Custom Design System: Hand-crafted CSS with glassmorphism, ambient glow effects, and responsive layouts.
🤖 Terminal Component: Interactive hero section with a Pythonic representation of developer skills.
📈 Comprehensive Showcase: Detailed sections for projects, skills, and professional achievements.
📱 Fully Responsive: Optimized for all screen sizes, from mobile to ultra-wide displays.
